d:
Navratri is a time for celebration, devotion and enjoying the festive flavours we all love!
And since the new generation is always looking for something new to try, this Navratri, I’m giving a globally loved dessert an Indian festive twist with Chocolate Sabudana Crème Brûlée!
Taking the classic crème brulee and giving it a delicious sabudana twist, this recipe puts one of our favourite Navratri ingredients in a completely new avatar. The creamy dessert gets a rich chocolatey touch with Nutralite Choco Spread Calcium, adding delicious chocolate flavour along with the goodness of calcium.
